s: Dine birkat erub ubo seip echad: mitzva lechazze(v)r achar shittupe meboot kemo achar erube chatzerot. Umebarek alayv "al mitzvat erub", veomer "bezeh hashshittup yehe muttar lekol bene hammaboy lehotzi ulehaknis mechatzerot lemaboy". Veim mishtattepim bepat vesomekin al shittup bimqom erub, veen meorbin bachatzerot kelal, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"z — yomar gam ken "mechatzerot lebattim". Ematay mebarek alayv? Beshaa shemmeqabbetz oto mibbene hammaboy o beshaa shemmezakkeh lahem, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"v. Veim lo berak velo amar alayv kelum — eno meakkeb, kemo shennitbaer sham:
